turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and was Owen heard first?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
It won't be easy. What do you have on Owen's essay?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. This is the one I picked. On what basis does it stand?
